i.n: chicken or beef stock (or use 750 mL passata and a stock cube)

method.s: Brown the diced chorizo in a pot. Add leek and garlic. Gently fry to soften.
Add spices and stir through for one minute until fragrant.
Deglaze the pan with a little of the stock.
Add remaining ingredients and bring to the boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 45 minutes to an hour, until the sauce has thickened to desired consistency. Cover and add water if starting to stick.
